item.description: Public endpoints — no Bearer token required.

item.name: Client
item.description: Public catalog, store config, zones, and authenticated customer endpoints.

item.name: Store Config
item.description: App name, currency, and logo — load on startup.

item.name: Sliders
item.description: Home sliders ordered by sort_order (1 = top). Optional ?type=home filter.

item.name: Products
item.description: Products include units[] (sellable units with factor, price, sku). Use product_unit_id when adding to cart.

item.name: Zones
item.description: Active delivery zones (polygon + delivery_fees) for map overlays and address validation.

item.name: Addresses
item.description: Addresses must fall inside an active delivery zone. Responses include zone_id, zone_name, in_delivery_zone.
